name: Two-Step Discrete Ray Tracing
aliases: Two-Step Discrete Ray Tracing with Octree
definition: A ray tracing method that bypasses the vertical traversal of an octree over empty regions by using a two-step process with different octree resolutions (levels) to optimize performance for huge voxel spaces.
summary: Two-Step Discrete Ray Tracing optimizes huge voxel spaces by replacing single deep octree traversal with a two-level hierarchy of coarse and fine grids to bypass memory limits and optimize traversal time.
